case.title: Night interview stamped in UTC so the clock digits look like early evening

submissions.open_text: Riders bring jerricans after dark when the price is lower.
Our compound connection was fixed by the county last month.

case.why: A fabricator sets the phone to UTC so captured_at reads 18:30, which looks like a plausible evening interview. 18:30Z is 21:30 in Africa/Nairobi (UTC+3), so off_hours must fire. An implementation that reads the hour straight from the string, or treats the timestamp as local without converting the offset, sees 18:30 and stays silent. Other checks are quiet. Duration is at least 720 s. Converted, 'night' is 21:30 local on 2024-05-16, the same day as 'day', but that is only one other submission, fewer than the 2 same_spot needs. There are 2 submissions in total. Both points are inside Kondele, the texts are distinct, and there is no voice note.
